caption: A man covered in multicolored powder—green, blue, red, and yellow smeared across his face, short hair, and white t-shirt—is framed against a purple backdrop. His right hand, its fingertips caked with yellow powder, is held cupped just below his mouth. A loose cloud of yellow-green dust already fills the air on the left side of the frame and steadily thins, spreads, and fades into a faint haze as the clip runs. His expression shifts from a pursed-lip look to a widening grin that bares his teeth, which he holds through the middle of the sequence. The cupped hand drifts slowly downward toward his chin. For most of the clip his eyes stay open, then close near the end as the smile deepens. The powder on his face, hair, and shirt remains essentially unchanged throughout.
